description: Three folios of accounts in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yosef. Mentions the term ṣāfī several times (in this case does not seem to be a person's name but a commercial term); sarcocolla (ʿanzarūt); the ṣāhib al-funduq; marāwiḥ (fans?); khazāsh silk ; a turban; Nuṣayr; Ibn Sughmār; Ibn Tībān; Khulayf; several "pieces" (qiṭʿa) of a certain good; ʿIwāḍ; lac; Abū Zikrī; and khazāsh and ḥarīr again.
